mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch ( ProdName, ProdOption, ProdCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate ) VALUES ( #{prodName}, #{prodOption}, #{prodCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch SET ProdName = #{prodName}, ProdOption = #{prodOption}, ProdCode = #{prodCode}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE ProdName = #{prodName}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch WHERE ProdName = #{prodName} AND ProdOption = #{prodOption} AND ProdCode <> '' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch (ProdName, ProdOption, ProdCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate) VALUES (#{prodName}, #{prodOption}, #{prodCode}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ProdCode = #{prodCode}, State = 1, ChangeId = #{registId}, ChangeName = #{registName}, ChangeDate = NOW()
